import java.io.*;

public class Codeforces {
    public static void main(String args[]) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader bu = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s[] = bu.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(s[0]);
        double p = Double.parseDouble(s[1]);

        int i = 1;
        while (i <= n && !(probab(n, i) >= p)) {
            i++;
        }
        System.out.println(i);
    }

    static int ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r > n) return 0;
        int ans = 1;
        for (int i = n; i > n - r; i--) ans *= i;
        for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) ans /= i;
        return ans;
    }

    static double probab(int n, int x) {
        int a = ncr(x, 3) * ncr(n - x, 0);
        int b = ncr(x, 2) * ncr(n - x, 1);
        int c = ncr(x, 1) * ncr(n - x, 2);
        return 1.0 * ((3.0 / 6.0) * c + a + b) / ncr(n, 3);
    }
}
